invariants.rationale: The method returns the value of the boolean expression '!scrollX || amountX <= 0', so the result always equals this expression.
If 'result' is false, then both 'scrollX' is true and 'amountX' > 0, so the disjunction must always hold.
If 'result' is true, then '!scrollX || amountX <= 0' must be true, capturing the logical equivalence.
If 'amountX' <= 0, then '(scrollX && amountX <= 0)' implies 'result' is true, so if 'result' is false, 'amountX' must be positive.
